facts.fact: The Bank of Zambia's 2024 e-money charges directives, issued under the National Payment Systems Act 2007 and the Bank of Zambia Act 2022 and binding on all e-money institutions, banks and financial institutions from 2 August 2024, set prohibited and capped e-money fees.
facts.system: Prohibition against Unwarranted Charges and Fees on Electronic Money Services Directives, 2024
